headline: White Mountains Insurance Group Reports Q3 2026 Results
summary: White Mountains Insurance Group reported a book value per share of $2,243 as of September 30, 2026. This represents a 1% decrease for the third quarter and a 3% increase for the first nine months of the year.
why: White Mountains is a financial services holding company. Book value per share is a primary metric used by investors to assess the intrinsic value of insurance and investment firms.
